CP-01.replay_rule: validated drawdown tiers reconstructed causally from cumulative adjusted close ATH

CP-02.replay_rule: same TQQQ_RULES precedence and state machine used by opportunity_strategy.py

CP-03.replay_rule: same RSI14, two-session RSI, 63-session drawdown and MA200 risk context thresholds used by opportunity_strategy.py

methodology.effective_n: signals with the same playbook/detail within <=5 QQQ trading sessions are collapsed into one cluster
methodology.confidence_interval: Wilson 95% interval on raw directional alignment rate; effective_n is displayed separately to prevent clustered events looking independent

guardrails: Historical replay is post-rule-design research evidence, never Forward evidence.
Replay cannot write the private Forward Ledger.
Blocked dependencies are not approximated to inflate sample size.
No replay statistic may automatically promote a rule or change production thresholds.
No option P&L is inferred from underlying returns.
